acceptanceCriteria: The commit in 8f4b866..b8fe75d that lowers trace2code recall@20 is identified by bisect with frozen-eval numbers.
Either the regression is fixed with the frozen evals rerun, or a recorded decision re-baselines it.
The diffusers c7ea7d6f code2test sample's docs-row change is attributed to a commit.
body: Residual of lane PR beamfall/corvint#1467 (recall-1021k, seal 764204705, base 58d4ed2d3). Comparing baseline 242fde6 with main 58d4ed2, trace2code recall@20 fell 0.7937 to 0.7640 while @10/@5 rose. Bisect attributes it to a range separate from the V1-2288 cause (de427c57f, V1-0431): 8f4b866..b8fe75d. Also unattributed: one code2test sample (diffusers c7ea7d6f) whose docs rows changed in another commit, which keeps variant E one sample under 0.5116.
title: retrieval quality: trace2code recall@20 dropped 0.7937 to 0.7640 in range 8f4b866..b8fe75d
